_: TERRA ACROSS THE STYLE LIBRARY. Per-style verdicts, set BY LOOKING at every cell, not inferred from any card. Two halves per style because a beautiful render of somebody else is a failure for a dossier: did the STYLE land, and is it still TERRA.

held_constant.framing: pinned - 'cowboy shot' first in the tag string
held_constant.anime: IPAdapter 0.0, LoRA character_terra_00001_v3 at 0.5, danbooru name stripped
held_constant.qwen: Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 reference route, sheet_photo_terra.png, style clause first, no character LoRA (base-model locked)

key.style: strong / partial / none - did the idiom actually arrive
key.id_3311: yes / drift / no - is it still Terra at the dossier seed
key.id_7788: yes / drift / no - and at the confirmation seed
key.drift: recognisably her, but something on her card changed - hair pushed to blonde, the face aged, or the figure pushed so far back the face is no longer legible

verified_by: Every cell opened and looked at. A pixel proxy for the hair failure was written, validated against fourteen cells already judged by eye, got four of them wrong, and was deleted - see build_heads().

american_comic.saw: Bold ink and saturated primaries. ONLY landed because neg_for_style dropped 'western comic' from the standing medium guard - the shipped negative would have condemned it.

arcane_magitech.saw: Glowing blue crystal at the ear and in the background; an accent, not a world. Red hair at 7788.

art_deco.saw: Gold sunburst halo, symmetry, geometric ornament. Identity untouched at both seeds.

art_nouveau.saw: Mucha panel with an ornamental border - and she still FILLS it. The only frame-building style that did not shrink her at either seed.

baroque_painting.saw: Chiaroscuro and gold brocade, genuinely beautiful. HAIR RED at both seeds.

bauhaus.saw: Primary red/blue/white blocking on the garment and a flat arch. No real geometric discipline.

byzantine_icon.saw: Gold-leaf ground arrived; the hieratic figure and egg-tempera face did not.

cel_anime_90s.saw: Heavier uneven line, duller warm palette, hard flat shadow, a period face. Full costume fidelity at both seeds.

charcoal_drawing.saw: Smudged greyscale with paper tooth. sat15.9. Costume simplifies to a long gown.

chibi.saw: Two heads tall, huge eyes, thick outline. Identity survives only as signature nouns - chibi erases facial structure by construction, so this is a loss by design rather than a failure.

concept_art.saw: Painted, moody, loose. HAIR RED at both seeds.

cottagecore.saw: d18.3 and essentially the control with a cream dress. Hair pushed toward blonde. The library records it REPLACING the setting with flowers on a generic subject; it did nothing here.

cubism.saw: No faceting anywhere at either seed. DISAGREES WITH THE LIBRARY VERDICT, which records the background fracturing into genuine cubist planes on a generic subject.

dark_academia.saw: Candlelit oak and moody warm brown. HAIR RED at both seeds.

dark_fantasy_anime.saw: Near-monochrome greys, ornate filigree costume, dramatic vault. d32.6. Her wardrobe is replaced wholesale by the idiom.

dieselpunk.saw: Olive-ochre industry, riveted hatch, smokestacks. Red hair at 7788.

eldritch.saw: d17.2 - very little eldritch quality reached the frame.

expressionism.saw: Distorted dark architecture, harsh reds, sat46.2. HAIR RED at both seeds.

flat_vector.saw: Flat unmodulated shapes, flat27.6. Red hair at 7788.

ghibli_pastoral.saw: Soft painted sky and blue cone-roofed towers; it rebuilds the place. Full identity at 3311, red at 7788.

giallo.saw: Lurid magenta and blue gels. Red hair at 7788.

golden_age_illustration.saw: sat48.2, the warmest illustration in the set, and every costume noun present - gold corset, red cape, red-and-blue sash, ribbon. Holds at both seeds.

gothic_illustration.saw: High-contrast B&W and tall architecture land hard, but this is the ONE style where the pinned shot size was partly overpowered even at 3311 - she is a mid-figure in a vast hall. At 7788 she is tiny and her hair is white.

gouache.saw: Flat opaque paint, poster-like. Green at 3311, RED at 7788 - one of the three styles that flipped and the reason the second seed was worth spending.

grimdark.saw: d35.6, the largest change from control in the whole sweep. Mud, rust, near-black. Green at 3311, RED at 7788.

idol_bright.saw: Sparkle bokeh, confetti, stage flare. Identity completely untouched at both seeds.

illuminated_manuscript.saw: Gold ground and jewel colour, sat43.4. Green at 3311; at 7788 it built a gold border and shrank her, and the hair went red with it.

impressionist.saw: Broken colour and soft light, but the hair drifts to pale blonde and the dress to white.

ink_wash.saw: Sumi-e with real wet black bleed on bare paper. HAIR RED at both seeds.

iyashikei.saw: d10.7, the smallest change in the sweep. Slightly softer and calmer than control and little else.

josei_muted.saw: Desaturated, grounded, and it AGES her - the face is harder and older than her card.

kyoani_soft.saw: Soft blue night, gentle gradients, bokeh. Identity intact at both seeds.

ligne_claire.saw: Uniform line weight and flat colour, edge30.5. Red hair at 7788.

linocut.saw: A carved block pattern reached the dress; no gouge marks, no relief-print character. Compare ukiyo_e, which is also a print idiom and lands completely.

low_poly_3d.saw: The ARCHITECTURE faceted (flat34.7, the flattest cell in the sweep); she stayed smooth anime. HAIR RED at both seeds.

manga_inked.saw: sat13.2 and edge33.5 - the most extreme line-to-colour ratio on the anime path. Stays clearly separate from manga_screentone.

manga_screentone.saw: Visible dot tone on dress and hair. Genuinely distinct from manga_inked, as the library predicted.

modern_anime.saw: Clean digital line and a cool grade. The gold dress goes white, which is a costume loss rather than an identity one.

monogatari_geometric.saw: Flat graphic colour blocking, flat30.2. Red hair at 7788.

oil_painting.saw: Visible brush loading and warm impasto, full costume fidelity, both seeds.

ova_80s.saw: Airbrushed 80s OVA shading and a period face. The most characterful cell in the sweep and identity is perfect at both seeds.

pencil_sketch.saw: Graphite hatch on white ground, unfinished edges. Holds at both seeds.

pixel_art.saw: A genuine hard-aliased pixel grid, and she is STILL recognisable through it. At 7788 the figure pulls back and the read weakens.

pop_art.saw: sat49.3. Flat saturated primaries and bold blocking; her green hair reads as a deliberate palette choice.

pre_raphaelite.saw: d17.5 - richer fabric and a warmer palette, but close to the control.

psychedelic_60s.saw: sat51.1, the most saturated anime cell. Concentric swirls and a rainbow arch; the costume becomes a psychedelic print, which is the idiom dragging its own subject matter.

retro_shoujo_70s.saw: edge34.2, the finest hatching in the sweep, big sparkling eyes, elaborate curls. Full costume fidelity at both seeds.

seinen_grounded.saw: sat20.2 and a harder, more realistic face - grounded in exactly the way the card promises, at the cost of softening who she is.

shojo_soft.saw: Pastel, flowers, sparkle; it replaces the courtyard with a vignette. Red hair at 7788.

shonen_action.saw: Heavier line, bolder shapes, ornate gold bodice. Holds at both seeds.

silhouette_poster.saw: d18.9 and no silhouette anywhere - the figure is fully rendered. The card's central premise did not arrive.

slice_of_life_anime.saw: Warm, gentle, everyday - a grade more than an idiom.

solarpunk.saw: Greenery and bright clean daylight overtake the courtyard. HAIR RED at both seeds.

steampunk.saw: Brass, oxidised copper, gears worn as costume rather than floating props. HAIR RED at both seeds.

storybook_illustration.saw: Soft pastel wash and open line; mild. Red hair at 7788.

trigger_kinetic.saw: sat42.5, angular kinetic architecture in complementary red and green. HAIR RED at both seeds - and red is the exact complement the palette clause is reaching for.

ufotable_glow.saw: Bloom and rim light. HAIR RED at both seeds.

ukiyo_e.saw: Flat keyblock colour, indigo/beni/ochre, and the noun-drag its own card warns about - the gold dress becomes a kimono with an obi. At 7788 it also built a print border, pushed her deep into the frame and turned her hair red: the clearest single demonstration in the sweep that composition and identity fail together.

vaporwave.saw: Teal and magenta, checkerboard floor, palms, 80s cel. Holds at both seeds.

voxel.saw: Isometric cube world and a voxelised dress. Red hair at 7788.

wasteland.saw: Ruined overgrown structures and dust. HAIR RED at both seeds.

watercolour.saw: Washes, tidemarks, bare-paper highlights, granulation - and full costume fidelity at both seeds. The ONLY painterly style that survived both; baroque_painting, ink_wash, gouache and impressionist all failed at one seed or both.

webtoon_flat.saw: Flat colour and simplified shading. Red hair at 7788.

woodcut.saw: Some carved line quality; not a relief print. Same shortfall as linocut.

wuxia.saw: Flowing silk, jade frog-clasps, a Chinese collar. Re-costumes her without losing her, at both seeds.

y2k_chrome.saw: Iridescent holographic dress and blue-white flare. The chrome lands on the GARMENT, which is what keeps it composable.

architectural_photo.saw: Corrected verticals, deep focus, low raking sun. Its negative_add asks for 'people, clutter', which qwen ignores at cfg 1.0 - so a style that forbids people rendered a person anyway.

blueprint.saw: The whole SET becomes a Prussian-blue line drawing with 'PLATE 04' lettering; she stays a full-colour photograph inside it. flat35.4. Striking, and not what the card describes.

brutalist.saw: The set goes raw grey concrete; she stays in colour. Same set-only conversion as blueprint.

cinematic_film_still.saw: Shallower depth, dark backdrop, directional key, filmic contrast.

cinestill_night.saw: sat68.5. Tungsten and cyan with halation - the cinestill signature, unmistakable.

claymation.saw: The SET becomes a miniature clay model - chunky well, modelled banners, clay sheen - and her face stays human. The reference pins the face, so the clay cannot reach her.

cross_processed.saw: sat59.9. Blown yellow-green crossover with crushed magenta shadows.

cyanotype.saw: Prussian blue monochrome on paper white.

cyberpunk_neon.saw: sat72.4. Magenta and cyan signage, wet reflective ground, fog. Note it puts neon signs in a medieval courtyard - a real anachronism to budget for.

documentary_photo.saw: d17.7 - flat available light and an unposed feel. Appropriately invisible.

eight_bit.saw: THE EXCEPTION THAT DEFINES THE RULE on this path: it converted HER as well as the set, because pixelation is a resampling that changes how she is drawn without changing her proportions. More 16-bit than 8-bit - far more than the twelve colours the card asks for.

film_35mm.saw: d15.1, the subtlest cell on this path. Warm, halated, softly rolled highlights.

infrared_photo.saw: White foliage, black sky, luminous skin. The most transformative photo cell that still keeps her completely.

kodachrome.saw: sat53.5. Warm saturated reds and blues in the specific Kodachrome register.

long_exposure_night.saw: Light trails across the cobbles and star-burst lamps with her held sharp.

neo_noir.saw: sat75.6, the most saturated cell in the entire sweep. Blue and magenta neon on wet stone. Collapses toward cyberpunk_neon on this subject - pick one.

noir_comic.saw: d36.9, the largest change from control on this path. Full ink conversion including HER - spot blacks, rain hatch, stipple on the cape. The ink lands; the card's 'no colour, no grey midtones' does not.

photorealistic.saw: d14.6, the smallest delta on this path, which is correct - the control is already a photograph.

pixar_3d.saw: The SET renders as clean CG; she stays a photoreal human. This style needs to re-proportion the PERSON and the reference will not allow it. The library records it landing on a generic subject, so this is a character-specific failure, not a card error.

pointillism.saw: Dots across the whole frame including her garment; her face stays smooth.

polaroid.saw: A real instant-film border with the thick bottom tab, plus the cyan-green shift. The style's own NOUN became the frame, which here is the correct behaviour rather than an injection failure.

security_camera.saw: Burned-in timestamp, fisheye barrel distortion, high corner mount, crushed blacks. Identity is only 'drift' because the style's whole point is putting her far away - that is the card working, not failing.

stop_motion_felt.saw: A soft fibre halo on the contours and nothing else - no stitching, no armature, no felt nap. Closest of any qwen card to the library's 'inert'.

street_bw.saw: sat3.0 - by a wide margin the least saturated cell in the whole sweep, on either engine. Unambiguous monochrome.

studio_portrait.saw: d16.5. A studio portrait in a courtyard is a contradiction and the reference route resolved it toward the courtyard.

tintype.saw: Plate vignette and chemical edge artefacts arrived; the monochrome did not - the tabard stays yellow.

war_photography.saw: sat24.2, smoke, grit, an out-of-focus foreground mask.

western_frontier.saw: Reads as a hot low-sun GRADE rather than a world - no frontier props at all.
